events.title: Baltimore Orioles vs. Milwaukee Brewers
events.description: The Orioles open a three-game series against the Brewers at Camden Yards, a quick trip up I-95 from DC and one of baseball's most beloved ballparks.

events.title: Baltimore Orioles vs. Milwaukee Brewers
events.description: Game two of the Orioles-Brewers series falls on the same day the Ravens open their home slate a few blocks away, making it a big sports Saturday in Baltimore.

events.title: Baltimore Orioles vs. Milwaukee Brewers
events.description: A nationally televised Sunday finale against Milwaukee caps a rare same-day doubleheader for Baltimore's two pro franchises at the Camden Yards sports complex.

events.title: Baltimore Ravens home opener vs. New Orleans Saints
events.description: The Ravens open their home 2026 season against the Saints, with kickoff hours before the Orioles play next door — a historic same-day doubleheader for Baltimore sports.

events.title: Maryland Terrapins Football vs. Virginia Tech
events.description: Maryland hosts Virginia Tech at SECU Stadium in a nationally broadcast non-conference tilt before Big Ten play begins the following week.

events.title: Garth Brooks: Blame It All On My Roots tour
events.description: Garth Brooks brings his stripped-down arena tour to DC for the first of two nights, part of a live recording project called Killer Live.

events.title: Garth Brooks: Blame It All On My Roots tour
events.description: A second sold-out-caliber night from Garth Brooks at Capital One Arena, the fourth stop on his 2026 arena run.

events.title: Jungle: World Tour 2026
events.description: British dance-soul outfit Jungle brings its kinetic live show and choreography to The Anthem's waterfront hall, with support from Rio Kosta.

events.title: Miel San Marcos & Gateway Worship
events.description: A seated evening of contemporary Christian worship music pairs Guatemalan group Miel San Marcos with Gateway Worship at The Anthem.

events.title: Malcolm Todd: Do That Again Tour
events.priceLabel: Sold out; check source for returns
events.description: Rising singer-songwriter Malcolm Todd closes the Wharf weekend with a sold-out show on his Do That Again tour, joined by 54 Ultra.

events.title: The Avett Brothers
events.description: The North Carolina folk-rock band opens a two-night stand under the stars at Wolf Trap's outdoor Filene Center amphitheater.
events.sourceName: Wolf Trap Foundation for the Performing Arts

events.title: The Avett Brothers
events.description: Night two of the Avett Brothers' Wolf Trap run, one of the last big lawn-and-pavilion shows of the Filene Center's outdoor season.
events.sourceName: Wolf Trap Foundation for the Performing Arts

events.title: Erykah Badu, De La Soul & The Alchemist
events.description: A landmark hip-hop and neo-soul triple bill brings Erykah Badu, De La Soul and producer The Alchemist together on the Filene Center stage.
events.sourceName: Wolf Trap Foundation for the Performing Arts

events.title: Ashley Cooke: The Baby Blues Tour
events.description: Country singer Ashley Cooke plays an early-evening headline set at the legendary 9:30 Club on her Baby Blues tour.

events.title: Brandon Flowers
events.description: The Killers frontman Brandon Flowers plays a rare solo club date at the 9:30 Club, his smallest DC stage in years.

events.title: Grouper
events.description: Ambient songwriter Liz Harris performs as Grouper in the ornate Lincoln Theatre, a rare full-band-scale room for her hushed, textural sound.

events.title: Mt. Joy: Celebrating 10 Years of Mt. Joy
events.description: Philadelphia folk-rock band Mt. Joy marks a decade together with an anniversary show at the wooded, shed-style Merriweather Post Pavilion.

events.title: Treaty Oak Revival: West Texas Degenerate Tour
events.description: Texas country-rap act Treaty Oak Revival headlines the outdoor amphitheater on its West Texas Degenerate tour.

events.title: Broccoli City 2026 feat. Summer Walker
events.description: DC's own Broccoli City Festival relocates to Jiffy Lube Live with R&B headliner Summer Walker plus kwn and Elmiene across the afternoon and evening.

events.title: LSR/CITY X by Gareth Emery
events.address: 2135 Queens Chapel Rd NE, Washington, DC 20018
events.description: Trance producer Gareth Emery headlines a late-night electronic show at Echostage with support from Andrea Botez, CVMRN and Dopastat.

events.title: Ian Asher
events.address: 2135 Queens Chapel Rd NE, Washington, DC 20018
events.description: DJ and producer Ian Asher plays a late-night set at Echostage with support from NOTD and Will Sass.

events.title: Annapolis Baygrass Music Festival — Saturday
events.description: A beachside bluegrass and jamgrass festival at Sandy Point State Park headlined by Little Feat, Yonder Mountain String Band and Béla Fleck, benefiting Chesapeake Bay conservation.

events.title: Annapolis Baygrass Music Festival — Sunday
events.description: The festival's closing day continues on two alternating stages with Sam Bush, Mountain Grass Unit, TopHouse and Shadowgrass.

events.title: Comedian CP
events.description: Comedian CP, known for credits including Detroiters and HBO, headlines two Friday-night sets at DC Improv's main room.

events.title: Comedian CP
events.description: Comedian CP's headlining run continues with two Saturday-night shows at DC Improv.

events.title: Comedian CP
events.description: A single closing show wraps Comedian CP's weekend headlining run at DC Improv.

events.title: DC Improv Stand-Up Showcase
events.description: Five stand-up comics rotate through a fast-paced showcase in DC Improv's smaller Lounge room.

events.title: T.J. Miller
events.description: Silicon Valley and Deadpool actor T.J. Miller headlines two Friday stand-up sets at The Comedy Loft's special-event room.

events.title: T.J. Miller
events.description: T.J. Miller's headlining run continues with two Saturday-night shows at The Comedy Loft.

events.title: Giulio Gallarotti
events.venue: The Comedy Loft of DC — The Cellar
events.description: Netflix stand-up special comic Giulio Gallarotti headlines two Saturday shows in The Comedy Loft's downstairs Cellar room.

events.title: Steph Tolev
events.description: Canadian comic Steph Tolev brings her raucous stand-up set to the 9:30 Club stage, a rare comedy booking for the venue.

events.title: H Street Festival
events.description: DC's 21st annual H Street Festival closes the corridor for a full day of live music, dance performances, art vendors and food trucks.

events.title: Maryland Renaissance Festival — Pirate Adventure weekend
events.description: The 50th-season festival's pirate-themed weekend brings swashbuckling entertainment to Revel Grove alongside jousting, artisan shops and 140-plus vendors.

events.title: Maryland Renaissance Festival — Pirate Adventure weekend
events.description: The pirate weekend continues with themed performances, jousting tournaments and live music through the festival's 50th-anniversary season.

events.title: The Great Frederick Fair — Saturday
events.description: County fair traditions continue with livestock shows, a carnival midway and a grandstand concert from LFO, O-Town and Ryan Cabrera's POP 2000 tour.

events.title: The Great Frederick Fair — Sunday
events.description: Youth and open livestock competitions run all day, capped by a grandstand performance from Neal McCoy and Mark Wills.

events.title: The Great Oktoberfest Crawl
events.description: DC's largest Oktoberfest bar crawl sends lederhosen-clad crowds through Dupont Circle's bars for discounted Bud Lights, rail drinks and Oktoberfest shots.

events.title: Falls Church Festival & Taste of Falls Church — 50th annual
events.address: 223 Little Falls St, Falls Church, VA 22046
events.description: Falls Church marks the 50th year of its signature festival with a beer garden, live music, kids' entertainment and dozens of local vendor booths.

events.title: Cox Farms Fall Festival — kickoff weekend
events.description: Northern Virginia's biggest fall festival opens its 2026 season with giant slides, hayrides, a corn maze and 90-plus acres of harvest-time fun.

events.title: Cox Farms Fall Festival — kickoff weekend
events.description: The second day of Cox Farms' opening weekend keeps the rope swings, farm animals and cider stands running through the evening.

events.title: Movies on the Potomac: How to Train Your Dragon
events.description: A free outdoor movie night on National Harbor's waterfront Plaza screens How to Train Your Dragon with the Potomac as a backdrop.

events.title: Salsa at Sunset with Orlando Machuca Jr.
events.description: A free outdoor salsa dance and live-music session lights up National Harbor's waterfront Plaza as the sun goes down.

events.title: Saturday Yoga Class powered by Onelife Fitness
events.description: A free outdoor yoga session on the waterfront Plaza offers a low-key way to start a National Harbor Saturday.

events.title: Eastern Market weekend farmers and flea market
events.description: The weekend outdoor market outside Eastern Market fills 7th Street SE with produce stands, flowers and an open-air flea and arts market.

events.title: FreshFarm Dupont Circle farmers market
events.description: More than 50 regional farmers and producers set up at DC's flagship Sunday market, with SNAP/EBT and FreshMatch benefits accepted.

events.title: Old Town Farmers' Market
events.address: 100 block N Royal St, Alexandria, VA 22314
events.description: The country's oldest continuously operating farmers market draws 70-plus vendors to its temporary North Royal Street home during Market Square renovations.

events.title: Rockville Farmers Market
events.address: Route 28 at Monroe St, Rockville, MD 20850
events.description: Downtown Rockville's Saturday market runs through the heart of its May-to-November season with regional produce and prepared foods.

events.title: Takoma Park Farmers Market
events.description: The year-round Sunday market sets up behind the Shops on Laurel Avenue with produce, baked goods and prepared foods from area farms.

events.title: Tomorrow the Sun Will Rise: 2026 juried exhibition — closing weekend
events.description: The last Saturday to see this juried show of 48 contemporary DC-region artists chosen from 1,500 open-call submissions before it closes Sunday.

events.title: Tomorrow the Sun Will Rise: 2026 juried exhibition — final day
events.description: Closing day for the Phillips' juried survey of Washington-area contemporary artists, included with general admission.

events.title: Dear America: Artists Explore the American Experience — closing day
events.venue: National Gallery of Art, West Building
events.address: Constitution Ave NW at 6th St NW, Washington, DC 20565
events.description: Final day for this free America250 exhibition of 115 works on paper by artists from Ansel Adams to Ruth Asawa exploring land, community and freedom.

events.title: A Better Life for Their Children: photographs by Andrew Feiler
events.description: Andrew Feiler's photographs and stories document the Rosenwald Schools built by Julius Rosenwald and Booker T. Washington across the segregated South.

events.title: Glenstone Museum Saturday visit
events.description: The modern and contemporary art museum's Pavilions building reopens after exhibition changes, with the Woodland Trail and Gallery open all weekend.

events.title: America's State Flowers: an America250 celebration
events.description: A free exhibit of living plants, botanical illustrations and herbarium specimens showcases every U.S. state and territory's official flower.

events.title: Nick Cave: Mammoth
events.address: 8th and G Streets NW, Washington, DC 20004
events.description: A major survey of Nick Cave's sculptural Soundsuits and large-scale installations fills SAAM's galleries through January 2027.

events.title: Kreeger Museum public docent tour — Friday
events.description: A 45-minute docent-led walk through the Philip Johnson-designed former Kreeger residence covers Monet, Picasso and Kandinsky works.

events.title: Kreeger Museum public docent tour — Saturday
events.description: The Saturday tour repeats the modern-art walkthrough of the Kreeger house, with a second afternoon tour also offered.

events.title: WalkingTown DC: Hillcrest Architecture — Hidden Gems of SE
events.description: Neighborhood historian Jim Byers leads a free walking tour through Hillcrest's architecture as part of Events DC's citywide WalkingTown DC program.

events.title: WalkingTown DC: Beyond the Insurrection — protest history on the National Mall
events.description: A licensed guide traces the history of political and social protest on the National Mall in this free WalkingTown DC tour.

events.title: Iron Blossom Festival — Saturday road trip
events.address: Midtown Green, W Leigh St, Richmond, VA
events.description: Richmond's boutique two-stage music festival, with no overlapping sets, makes a standout road trip for rock and electronic fans.

events.title: Iron Blossom Festival — Sunday road trip
events.address: Midtown Green, W Leigh St, Richmond, VA
events.description: The festival's second day closes the weekend in Richmond with another full, non-overlapping program across its two stages.
